title: Implement alcanzai ingest CLI command in alcanzai-interaction
description:
First real code in alcanzai-interaction. Implement the alcanzai ingest <identifier> command.

Entry point: python -m alcanzai_interaction ingest <identifier>

Flow (synchronous subprocess, ADR-011):
1. Detect source: iterate registered Sources, call can_handle(identifier), claim first match (ArxivSource for M2).
2. Source.resolve(identifier) → CanonicalId.
3. Create job dir: .alcanzai/jobs/<uuid>/ (UUID v4).
4. Source.fetch(canonical) → FetchResult (PDF written to job dir as artifact.pdf; path recorded in source_metadata).
5. Source.normalize(fetch_result) → base RawDocument.
6. run_enrichment_pipeline(raw_document, enrichers=[GrobidStructureEnricher(), CitationEnricher()]) → enriched RawDocument.
7. Write enriched RawDocument to <job-dir>/raw_document.json (atomic: .tmp then rename).
8. Subprocess: alcanzai ingest-job --library <library-path> --job-dir <job-dir>. Wait for exit.
9. Read result.json. Print KO id (or existing KO id on exact_match). Exit non-zero on error.

Library path: ALCANZAI_LIBRARY env var or --library flag.

Acceptance:
- Unit test (no network, no GROBID, no Rust binary): mock Source + coordinator + subprocess call; assert job dir written correctly and subprocess invoked with correct args.
- uv run pytest -m 'not integration' passes.
